info.name: New
info.description: Contains only APIs explicitly requested by the project owner.

query.description: Required latitude (-90 to 90), except for BSL subject searches.
Required longitude (-180 to 180), except for BSL subject searches.
Optional radius: greater than 0, maximum 500 km; default 7.
Optional existing numeric subject ID. Set the variable and enable to use. BSL subjects use the designated global institute branch.

request.description: Public home/map dashboard; no bearer token or /api prefix. Returns center, radiusKm, teacherCount, instituteCount, totalCount and results. Ordinary dashboard results include eligible nearby teachers/institutes plus institutes marked is_bsl or is_bsl_official regardless of radius, once each. Results sort by referral points descending, then BSL/official status, distance ascending, type and numeric user ID. Counts match returned listings. Suspended, unregistered or phone-unverified accounts are excluded in the ordinary branch. Missing BSL coordinates and distance are null. Explicit BSL subject searches retain their dedicated routing. Rate limit: 60 requests/minute per IP. Saved 200 response is a fictional illustration of relevant fields, not a live capture. Saved sample illustrates returned fields and does not demonstrate ranking. rating_avg is the account point score (100 points = 100 rating); review_rating_avg retains the actual review average; rating_count is 100 plus actual review count; review_rating_count preserves the actual count. referral_rating retains the legacy five-star conversion.
